title: Canonical spectrum comparison for affine base changes
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram, $c$ a colimit cocone, $i\in I$, $Z$ an affine scheme, and $t:Z\to\operatorname{Spec}R_i$ a morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Let $F$, $Y$, and the ring cocone $b$ be the canonical constructions of [def-pc-affine-descent-ring-diagram]. Then the specified morphism $Y\to\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O)\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Spec}(\operatorname{colim}.desc\ b)}\operatorname{Spec}(\operatorname{colim}F)$ is an isomorphism. No Noetherian or finite-presentation hypothesis is required.

proof.text: The upper-tail inclusion is final by Functor.final_of_exists_of_isFiltered and common upper bounds. Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv restricts hc to the tail. Spec preserves limits, giving the limiting spectral cone. Build the stage base-change cone with its canonical legs and use isLimitOfIsPullbackOfIsConnected with isPullback_baseChangeMap to prove it limiting.

The stages and vertex are affine. The existing Mathlib preservation instance for Scheme.Γ sends this limit to a colimit. Reindex the double opposite using opOpEquivalence and identify the resulting functor and cocone with the explicit affineDescentRings and affineDescentRingCocone. Uniqueness of colimit vertices makes colimit.desc b an isomorphism. The affine toSpecΓ and Spec of this ring isomorphism give the result.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean proof using Mathlib filtered-finality, connected pullback limits, and affine Scheme.Γ preservation; no new hole.

theorem isIso_affine_descent_colimit_toSpec
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c) (i : I)
    (Z : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Z] (t : Z ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) :
    IsIso ((pullback t (Spec.map (c.ι.app i))).toSpecΓ ≫
      Spec.map (colimit.desc _ (affineDescentRingCocone R i t c)))
